units.title: Introduction to business management
units.embeddedHlScope: All syllabus content is common. HL records require Porter, regression or the HL-only Paper 3 plan.

units.title: Human resource management
units.embeddedHlScope: 2.2 project-based and shamrock organizations; 2.3 scientific/intuitive thinking; 2.4 McClelland, Deci/Ryan, equity/expectancy, turnover, appraisal and recruitment are HL. Force field and Hofstede toolkit are HL.

units.title: Finance and accounts
units.embeddedHlScope: 3.4 straight-line and units-of-production depreciation are HL. 3.8 NPV is HL; payback and ARR are common. Contribution/absorption costing toolkit is HL.

units.title: Marketing

subtopics.title: The seven Ps of the marketing mix

units.embeddedHlScope: 4.1 evaluation of market share/leadership is HL. 4.5 dynamic/competitive/contribution pricing and PED are HL. All seven Ps are common. Regression, Gantt, CPA, contribution and Hofstede toolkit are HL.

units.title: Operations management
units.embeddedHlScope: 5.5 break-even contribution per unit is common; toolkit make/buy, contribution costing and absorption costing are HL. CPA, Gantt, regression, Hofstede and force field are HL.
